rationale.complete: Round 1 done in two layers: replication on all 35 non-holdout periods (27 scorable for friction) plus four native tests (G51 roles, G12 judges, G16 operator rules, G38 loop-densest week), each with dated predictions. The correction sensor was validated blind (the a priori lexical marker failed and was replaced, Amendment 1). Synthetic validation on real structures found and fixed a targeting confound (Amendment 2). confirm.py is written and dry-run; it needs a small Jev pass that could not run (API credit). Not done: a high-recall sensor (so the immune test is underpowered), H16 TS3/TS4, any NE event study.
rationale.faithfulness: The friction model is refuted in reverse with adequate power: correctors receive warmer replies (meta rho -0.24, p 0.04), with no reply-level friction. The immune model is not testable at the sensor's recall (power 0.08-0.21 at a modest effect); point estimates are null or negative. Only descriptive HH210 coverage and the generic address effect hold. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: An operator learns two things: peer correction carries no social cost here (correctors are treated well), and the swarm almost never corrects a stuck agent (0.65% of loops; operator rules not peer-enforced), so error correction must be supplied from outside. The one lever (address a looping agent: +0.05 escape per message) is small, partly mechanical and echoes H29/H16.

one_line: Correctors get warmer replies (ρ −0.24, 27 periods); corrections reach 0.65% of loop episodes with no detectable effect; being addressed raises escape by 5 points.

models.note: Viability value of corrections unmeasurable at sensor recall 0.1
Corrections do not beat neutral escape; being addressed does
Signed stance fields with calibrated agent-field null

v2.claim: Peer correction carries no stance cost: agents who correct more receive no colder, if anything warmer, replies (random-effects rho -0.24 [-0.44, -0.02] over 27 periods; replies to a correction no colder than to the same agent's other messages), and corrections almost never reach looping agents (0.65% of loop episodes vs 35% that receive any directed message).

ladder.factor: base: pre-registered primary (P1, P2, P8 dated before any outcome; sensor rule fixed in Amendment 1 before any outcome statistic; rho <= 0 was the stated falsifier)
calibrated null (synthetic on real reply graphs with measured label noise: P1 size 0.02-0.07, meta power > 0.9 at rho 0.4)
penalty: correction sensor recall about 0.1 (c_j a scaled rate; agent independence unchecked)
penalty: stance labels noisy; warmth may be a labeller habit (one blind rater)

v2.decision: operator / scaffold builder: do not rely on peers to correct a stuck agent; supply correction from outside the peer network; enforcers need no protection
v2.generality: read-out-gated swarms (0); no readiness (needs an LLM correction labeller)
v2.rater: adjudicated 2026-10-04 (coordinator vs blind rater; see adjudication note)

raters.claim: Scope: 27 non-holdout periods, DQ2 correction subtype. Peer correction is not an immune response: corrections reach <1% of restatement loops and show no detectable effect on escape, correctors draw no colder (if anything warmer) replies, and any addressed message raises per-step loop escape by ~5 points.

ladder.factor: calibrated null: synthetic on real reply graphs and loop structures (friction tests calibrated)
penalty: correction sensor recall ~0.1 (precision 0.93, one rater)
penalty: addressed effect may be mechanical (an answer is not a restatement)

v2.scope: 27 non-holdout periods, DQ2 confident correction/decline subtype (precision 0.93, recall about 0.1); the immune contrast is underpowered and not claimed
v2.adjudication_note: V judgement driven by the claim: the blind rater's claim included the 'address an agent to break its loop' lever (+5 points per step) and scored V 3, while the coordinator's claim was the descriptive friction and coverage result (V 1.5). Ruling: the address effect is a pre-registered descriptive with an open mechanical confound and is absent in #38 and #51, and the immune contrast is an unpowered negative, so both stay out; the scored claim is the powered friction test plus coverage, at primary base since rho <= 0 was the pre-stated falsifier, with V small for the external-correction decision.
